samples.question: Bottom disks are black (filled) or white (hollow). Each hollow middle circle takes the majority color of the three disks linked to it, and the hollow top circle takes the majority color of the five middle circles. Three bottom disks are ringed. Flipping exactly one of those three disks to its other color, changing nothing else, would change the top circle's color. Which ring marks that disk? Answer amber, teal, or violet.
